claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Separate strong coverage of the already-known triangle subcase and of general vertex-sum minimal-fort constructions from the genuinely additional complete all-fort generating polynomial and parameterized exact size spectrum. The latter cannot follow from a theorem enumerating only minimal forts, because information about all nonminimal forts is logically absent. Hence the full joint claim is not subsumed by the inspected prior source.

value.rationale: The complete all-fort and minimal-fort cardinality polynomials of the natural arbitrary-length cactus-bouquet family provide nontrivial two-sided hub decomposition, exact Fibonacci total, endpoint restriction and sharp failed-zero-forcing multiplicities. The result fills an identifiable structural extension beyond known triangle windmills and general minimal-fort gluing. No vague downstream impact or unproved general-cactus theorem is claimed.
